- Meat/sausage: 36 g x 250 kcal/100g ≈ 90 kcal
- Mashed potato: 322 g x 110 kcal/100g ≈ 354 kcal (made with butter/milk)

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total ≈ 485 g and ≈ 570 kcal. For a plate about half covered with a mashed-potato mound and roasted vegetables, this is plausible for one serving.
